name: thunder-deep-review
description: Read-only review of a Thunderbolt pull request, diff or branch against the house rules and the 80 architecture invariants. Catches wrong abstraction layers, coupling, convention drift, undocumented intent, bloat and supply-chain risk, and readability problems, alongside real bugs. Use when asked to review, code-review or deep-review a PR, diff or branch, or to review before merge. Reports findings; never edits code or posts to the PR.

findings.excerpt: - **R-HTTP** — use the app's `HttpClient` (`src/lib/http.ts`): `getHttpClient()` for authed backend calls, `http` for external APIs. No bare `fetch()`.
